scientific_integrity: All numerical diagnostics are finite checks. The mathematical argument is analytic. The general annulus topology and special q=1 or purely skew cases from earlier sources are credited, not presented as novel.
scientific_limitations: The exact formulas are for nonzero scalar multiples of antiunitaries on complex dimension two; no statement for general antilinear operators or higher dimension.
title: Exact constrained numerical annuli for planar antiunitaries
